title: Siman 148
section: His Journey to the Land of Israel

segments.he: וַיְהִי הַיּוֹם בִּשְׁנַת תק"ס רָאָה רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה בְּמָקוֹם שֶׁרָאָה וְהִשִּׂיג בְּמָקוֹם שֶׁהִשִּׂיג שֶׁהוּא צָרִיךְ לִקְבּעַ דִּירָתוֹ בִּקְהִלַּת זְלַטִיפָּלְיֶע. וּבְאוֹתוֹ הַשָּׁנָה בְּסוֹפוֹ בְּראשׁ חֹדֶשׁ אֱלוּל עָשָׂה נִשּׂוּאִין לְבִתּוֹ אָדִיל הַנַּ"ל, וְהַחֲתֻנָּה הָיְתָה בַּחֲמֶלְנִיק, וְהָיָה שָׁם עַל הַחֲתֻנָּה עִם כָּל בְּנֵי
segments.en: (20.) (This too [was said] before the Land of Israel journey.) "The entire world needs me — not to mention you and your like, as you yourselves know. But even those tzaddikim who can already pray — I can show them that they do not know at all what prayer is, and show them a path in prayer. And also even very great tzaddikim who already walk only in yichudim [unifications] — I can show them that they do not know at all the path in yichudim, and show them a path in yichudim." And it seems he enumerated yet several more such matters.
